title: lint: under a package closure, an out-of-closure object reference is refused at the dataset and view doors but only advised at the flow door (`flow-trigger-unknown-object` is `warning` and not closure-keyed) — one policy across three doors?
body:
Filing gate: **a policy divergence between three save doors, for a decision.** Reader: triage, for the grade and the route. It is protocol-class, and the 「是否提前」 rule applies (`6261447528`). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549), session `session_019oFY6Hi35J7atvgVFnmoaK`. The source is out-of-scope finding (b) of PR #24630: the seat check `6273946447`, finding (b), and the contract review `6278531343` ③. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured (read from source at PR #24630's head `700c21cbbd`)

| door | rule | severity under a package closure | keyed to the closure? |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `dataset` (`datasets[].object`) | `object-reference-unknown` | `error` for an unprefixed name (`validate-object-references.ts:265`) | yes: the snapshot's objects are narrowed |
| `view` (list view binding) | `list-view-object-outside-closure` | `error` (PR #24630, ruling B `6273946447`) | yes: it fires only when the gate states a closure |
| `flow` (trigger object) | `flow-trigger-unknown-object` | `warning` (`validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts:448`, `:500`) | no: it fires for any object the stack does not carry, with `sys_`-prefixed names excepted |

So the same mistake, a reference to an object of a package the writer never declared, is refused at two doors and advised at the third. The flow advisory has its own stated rationale: a trigger on an object that another installed package declares.

Governing text: ruling #9612 (「客户开发开发,校验是否也应该基于软件包…当然这里面要考虑系统对象」), which bases validation on the package's closure. The pm-dispatch decision principle: "two implementations of one operation that behave differently ⇒ the governed side wins".

## The question

Should the flow door refuse an out-of-closure trigger object under a stated package closure, as the dataset and view doors now do? Or does the flow door keep its advisory, with the reason recorded as a deliberate divergence?

Not analysed here: who writes cross-package flow triggers today. That is the first measurement for the decision.

## Dedupe

I ran a semantic issue search for `flow-trigger-unknown-object advisory warning out of closure package object reference flow door refuse`. It returned 15 hits, all about other flow doors (#21325, #14153, #22310 and others). None names this divergence.
